newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-SCHUMACHER TO STAY WITH FERRARI SAYS AGNELLI.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-SCHUMACHER TO STAY WITH FERRARI SAYS AGNELLI.

text.p: Michael Schumacher is set to stay with Ferrari for the next two or three years, the Italian company's honorary chairman Giovanni Agnelli said at the weekend.

Schumacher joined Ferrari in 1995 and helped the Italian team take second place in the Formula One constructors' world championship this season. He also won three races and finished third in the drivers' championship.
"Much of this was naturally due to Schumacher's ability," Agnelli told state broadcaster RAI. "He will stay at Ferrari for another two or three years," he added.
The German's contract expires at the end of 1997.
